end.parentNote: Asha practised placing BCE years in descending order toward 1 BCE and then moving into CE; Aarav correctly ordered 3000 BCE, 500 BCE, 100 CE, and 1947 CE. They also discussed archaeological remains, inscriptions, texts, and oral traditions, but the mix-up that one written source should be fully believed was still present at the end. At home, ask Aarav what different sources—such as a coin, inscription, book, or oral account—can each tell us, and why more than one source is useful.
